source_confidence_reason: Direct year-end finance ministry budget report with exact realized figures; strong for outcome and execution tracing.
period_fit: Retrospective on the full 2022 budget year.
ruler_attribution: Attributable to the Erdoğan-led fiscal program and Treasury administration, while inflation and exchange-rate conditions also affected nominal totals.
contrary_evidence: Nominal totals are inflated by price level changes.
The figures show budget execution, not whether spending was efficient or well-targeted.

title: 2023 Yılı Yatırım Programı Yayımlandı
publisher: T.C. Cumhurbaşkanlığı Strateji ve Bütçe Başkanlığı
claim: The 2023 investment-program article says that 5,086 projects' planned investments were completed in 2022 and that 3,607 new projects were added to the 2023 program.
locator: the paragraph beginning '2022 yılında 5.086 adet...' in the article snippet
source_confidence_reason: Official retrospective on completed 2022 investment activity; strong for project-delivery evidence, though still self-reported and not an audit.
period_fit: Published right after the 2022 investment year and explicitly summarizes 2022 completion.
ruler_attribution: Attributable to the Erdoğan-led investment planning system and line ministries, though delivery also depended on contractors and inherited project pipelines.
contrary_evidence: Completion counts do not show timeliness, quality, or cost control.
Some completions may reflect carryover projects started earlier.

title: Yönetim Bilgi Sistemi (YBS) Muhasebe Raporlama Platformu
publisher: T.C. Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı Muhasebat Genel Müdürlüğü
claim: The finance ministry said that in 2022 the YBS reporting system was opened to spending units and allowed them to view budget, revenue, expenditure, balance-sheet and other accounting reports online.
locator: paragraph describing rollout to 'harcama birimleri' and report types
source_confidence_reason: Primary administrative notice showing a concrete reporting/monitoring tool deployment; strong for management capacity, weaker for proof of better outcomes.
period_fit: Directly within 2022.
ruler_attribution: Institutionally attributable to the Erdoğan-led finance apparatus as a management and monitoring improvement, but it is still a tooling rollout rather than outcome evidence.
contrary_evidence: A reporting platform does not itself prove stronger delivery.
The notice says the system could be used, not that it changed decisions or results.
